checkout_flow: Mobile: User taps upgrade → Zustand store sets pendingTier → expo-web-browser opens LS hosted checkout URL with variant_id, checkout[email], checkout[embed]=false → User completes payment in LS overlay → LS redirects to app via expo-linking deep link (passeggiatafurba://subscription/confirm) → Client calls tRPC subscription.sync → Server validates via LS API GET /v1/subscriptions/{id} → DB upsert → Client receives subscription status → Paywall dismisses. Web fallback: Same flow but redirect to web app URL. On payment failure: LS retries up to 4 times over 14 days → webhook order_refunded or subscription_expired triggers ad-tier downgrade.
